thread:
Elena: Following up from the all-hands pricing section — I'll answer quick Qs here. Drop specifics and we'll triage.

Lola: Quick one — do per-route quotas count embeddings tokens differently from chat tokens or is it all aggregated?

Priya: They are separate meters in billing today. Embeddings consumed tokens are billed under embeddings_meter and chat/generation under token_meter. Aggregation shows org total but Console lets you break down by meter.

Marco: Adding: for customers that need split billing per product team we can create "quota namespaces" that map routes and API keys to different buckets. Ping Sales/SRE for setup.

Jun: Are there soft 429s vs hard 429s? We saw spikes where the client got a 429 but the header said "retry-after: 0".

Elena: Good catch. Soft 429s are throttles where we suggest retries (they include Retry-After). Hard 429s are quota-exceeded events and won't relax until the bucket refills or an exception is granted. If you see Retry-After: 0, escalate to support with the request-id header.

Lola: For purchases — can customers pre-book a migration window so we don't have to ask for one-off exceptions?

Priya: We're piloting a "reservation window" feature. Customers can reserve a temporary elevated daily cap for up to 7 days. It shows as a line-item in billing. Pilot next month; request via your account rep.

Marco: Small product note — the Console will show a "request reservation" flow in beta, but for now it's manual.

Jun: Any CLI or API to request smoothing/ reservation today?

Elena: Internal endpoint exists for support only. CLI example we use internally:

```
# pseudo-cli
redwood support request-reservation --org acme --start 2026-04-10 --days 3 --peak-tokens 12_000_000
```

Priya: Also, we now expose predictive overage alerts. You can set a threshold (e.g., 85% projected burn for next 7 days) to trigger email + slack alert to owners.

Lola: Credit expiry question — our partner needs rollover for unused credits for 3 months. Any change?

Priya: Policy unchanged: dev credits expire in 12 months. For enterprise customers we can offer custom rollover in contract. Sales/Solutions can start conversations.

Marco: One more — how do burst credits interact with reservations? If you reserve, do we still apply burst credits?

Elena: Reservation raises the daily cap and is charged normally. Burst credits are independent: if a tenant has burst credits, they will be consumed for above-plan usage until exhausted. Reservation doesn't consume burst credits unless configured.

billing-bot: Docs (internal draft): https://docs.redwood.ai/pricing/reservations-smoothing :link:

allhands-bot: Action: to request a pilot reservation react with :rocket: and tag @Priya with org + dates.

Elena: Closing — we'll compile an FAQ and add a short "migration checklist" to the product docs this week. Thanks all.
